correctness.rationale: The local multiplicative decomposition is exact. The exponent-one contribution is nu_ell(p+1); the mean absolute discrepancy from higher exponents is bounded by C_ell sum_p sum_{e>=2} e log(p)/p^e, which converges. The truncated additive function has mean coefficient \(\sum_{j\le J}1/\varphi(\ell^j)\), concentration follows from Turan–Kubilius, and the tail vanishes after J tends to infinity using the uniform prime-progression bound. The coefficient sum is \(\ell/(\ell-1)^2\).
